sentences.text:
Mohammad Yousuf And Another vs The State Of Telangana And
3 Others on 13 August, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.7360 of 2020
Order:

entities.text:
Mohammad Yousuf And Another vs The State Of Telangana And
3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioners, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the 2nd respondent in issuing an impugned Proceedings to the Petitioners through R.C.No.C2/16/Kannala/2016/26 and 27,
dated 05.03.2020 in pursuance of the land acquisition of the each petitioners to an extent of 556.435 Sq.Mts., which is equal lent to 665.5 Sq.yards situated in Survey No.109 of Kannala Village, Mandal: Bellampally Districtm, Mancherial by paying meager Compensation, instead of paying the Lawful Compensation, which is in accordance with law as per Market Value as illegal, arbitrary, unjust, unfair,
irrational, unreasonable, perverse, mockery, unlawful, unconstitutional, violative of Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and also against to the Principles of Natural Justice and against to the provisions of the Right to Pay Compensation and in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and against to the catena of Judgments of this Honorable Court and an Apex Court and consequently direct the respondents to pay the lawful compensation which is present market value to the petitioners in acquisition of the land of the each petitioners to an Extent 556.435 Sq.Mts., which is equal lent to 665.5 Sq.yards situated in Survey No.109 of Kannala Village, Mandal: Bellampally District,
Mancherial and to pass..."
2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, Sri Prabhakar Chikkudu, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners has submitted that the issue involved in this writ petition is squarely covered by the order, dated 28.07.2022 passed by this Court in W.P.No.1025 of 2021.
3.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the respondents has not disputed about the said fact.
4. Following the said order, this Writ Petition is disposed of in terms of the order, dated 28.07.2022 passed by this Court in W.P.No.1025 of 2021.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
